RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel at a public broadcaster may raise questions about diversity practices and unconscious affinity bias, but it is not definitive proof of discrimination on its own. Strategic priorities, such as digital transformation, frequently drive appointments over tenure.

Before challenging the panel's composition, follow up firmly on your written feedback. Review your employer's recruitment guidelines to check whether balanced panels are mandated. If the explanation lacks substance, conflicts with the job criteria, or reveals procedural breaches, raising the issue through HR or a union representative is sensible. If the hiring rationale is robust and objective, formally alleging bias could damage professional standing without changing the outcome.
